## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy retry limit should be fixed because it exceeds the existing project policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds an inventory health probe, a legacy inventory fetcher, and tests for successful calls, HTTP errors, and exhausted retries. It also adds a legacy exception to the documented retry cap.

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy fetches at three attempts — When the legacy endpoint repeatedly raises OSError, your fetcher makes eight attempts. This violates `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an upstream outage, the extra attempts prolong worker blocking beyond the limit established to prevent it. — Fix: Reduce MAX_ATTEMPTS to 3 and update the legacy case in `tests/test_retries.py`.
